knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Returned product can carry skin cells and organisms into the whole container, so unused oil is never returned to the main bottle.
Without a written laundering standard the hygiene level cannot be shown. Single-use sheets stay in use until the standard is confirmed.
The lesson says single-use linen costs more per session but removes the laundering step, while reusable linen costs less per session but must be laundered to a standard.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate decant oil for a simulated client into a clean, labelled dispenser and discard or clean the dispenser after the session
Assessor checks that a safety data sheet is filed in the kit for each product in use
Assessor checks that the candidate's linen record names the method used for each session type
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Decanting and labelling record for the simulated session
Safety data sheet file with the date checked
Linen method record for each session type
stopWorkCriteria: Used oil is returned to the main bottle
Reusable linen is used with no confirmed laundering method
A product is in use with no safety data sheet on hand
